policies.B1: Equipment approval on durability grounds requires a yearly failure proportion of 1.0% or less.
policies.B2: An entity gains top-tier quality certification provided it meets equipment approval on durability grounds.
policies.D1: Priority marketplace entry is granted to a supplier with top-tier quality certification that maintains an indemnity protection limit of at least $5,000,000.
policies.B3: A firm attains clinical safety validation if it possesses valid regulatory sanitary site authorization.
policies.B4: An enterprise is eligible for technology funding if its yearly turnover dedicated to research reaches at least $10,000,000.
policies.B5: A supplier gains eco-friendly provider status if its yearly renewable power fraction reaches at least 50%.

decoy_policies: A commercial enterprise receives preferred contractor status if its staff compliance score exceeds 90 points.
Commercial partners receive expedited customs clearance if they hold an active ISO 14001 certification.
